parsed.name: SHFQA 扫频软件模块
parsed.description: 这是一个面向 Zurich Instruments SHFQA 的非物理扫频软件模块，用于配置频率范围、射频收发、平均、触发和脉冲包络等参数，并执行扫频、返回结果和绘图。它常用于量子器件、谐振器或频谱响应测量流程中的自动化扫描。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical sweeper software module for the Zurich Instruments SHFQA. It configures sweep range, RF I/O, averaging, trigger, and pulse envelope settings, then runs sweeps, returns results, and plots data. It is commonly used in automated measurements of quantum devices, resonators, or frequency-response experiments.
